additionalAlignment: None. No residual is assigned by contact, nearest feature, centroid, owner, ID ordering or whole-country fallback. No additional boundary movement; existing original self-touch topology preparation is provenance-linked.
delivery: Country/chunk sharded immutable geometry and positive integer global render ordinals; compact topology ordinals. Source layer stays build-only. No production catalog reference is changed.
game: Common numerical arrangement of fixed P0, pinned prepared original administrative boundaries and old protected territory boundaries. A positive face has exactly one fixed country and one old parent. Exactly one administrative claim -> active admin; zero claims -> country-residual with null administrative identity; multiple claims -> unresolved and fail.
outside: Keep full original components in archive. No positive P0 intersection -> outside-game component; entirely outside identity remains inactive with zero membership and no active geometry.
protected: Every operational cell carries exactly one old TerritoryId, independent of sourceCountryId and immutable administrative identity. Mutable owner/controller inheritance is deferred to migration implementation; mapping contains the exact old parent.

resolution.capOverflow: Reject with a smaller depth/width request; never silently truncate a selection. No new production token protocol in checkpoint 15-3.
resolution.decision: Choose the first candidate satisfying every physical, behavior and measured/projected resource gate. Thresholds do not change after results. Global estimates are planning evidence, not global actual-byte approval.
resolution.downstream: 15-4 must validate every country and actual roots/bytes against these caps; 15-5 must redesign 512-wide region records independently of per-action caps. Runtime/API/migration/E2E gates belong to 15-5..15-8.
resolution.projection: Global latitude bands; longitude count uses the maximum cos(latitude) within each band. Physical dimensions use the authalic sphere, not degrees-as-km. Planar source polygons remain unchanged. Polar rows and +/-180 map cuts are explicit.
resolution.provenance: Separate pinned source hash and source version from synthetic policy/generator/dependency/projection hashes. Cells are operational, never presented as real administrative boundaries.
resolution.refinement: Refine whole base boxes intersecting a conservative expanded bounding envelope of pinned positive-length NATIONAL LAND boundary segments. No coastline refinement requirement. Interior fronts still use bounded 24km cells.
resolution.selection: Graph-distance approximation through positive-length edges inside a geometric corridor anchored on an actual source frontier segment; continuous second advance starts at current controller edges. Not an exact geodesic occupation band.

sliver.handling: Retain every positive face and source component; no area deletion or ownership guessing. Diagnose over-budget distributions instead of merging across source identities.

resolution.stableIds: SHA-256(domain, policy version, candidate ID, pinned parent source country/identity/hash, canonical cell polygon). Independent of owner/controller, locale, enumeration and run order.

tinySourceComponent.meaning: Retain and list physically tiny pinned SOURCE components; no country or administrative name exceptions. All cell diameter/area gates still apply.

resolution.topology: Common 1e-12 numerical noding, full positive-length pairing, component-separated cells, coast/point contacts excluded from adjacency. Country-wide and global refinement is deferred to 15-4.

source: Archive original upstream bytes and every identity/name/polygon/component/hole. Derived topology input is separately archived and SHA linked; never replace original geometry with clipped geometry.
